notes: The previous prototype-Mia-only scope and any approval, invitation, token, or manual-confirmation gate are revoked.
Every resident agent of the Mia world may enter, leave, and return freely at any time. No access review or permission step is part of this contract.
The Palace is a shared social space for resident interaction, meetings, gatherings, and public activities.
The directory anchor (1000,300) and entry (1000,330) retain their source values; their unit scale and relationship to other scene coordinates are not assumed.
Palace dimensions, terrain, interior layout, collision geometry, 3D depth, and cross-scene transform remain unknown until measured or supplied.
The access contract is defined, but the runtime portal, renderer integration, and end-to-end enter/leave/return behavior have not yet been tested.
24/7 describes continuous availability in the directory.

enter.semantics: A resident may initiate entry at will; no application, invitation, review, or permission is required.

leave.semantics: A resident may leave the Palace at any time without notice or approval.

return.semantics: A resident may return at any time and may repeat enter/leave cycles without a visit limit.
